lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#2 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it San Francisco 49ers -2.8 with a fair total of 46.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is San Francisco 49ers pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits +0.075 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
